tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, cart, tables. Default text ground.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs, tiles that sit above a surface.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: summary blocks, inputs groups, disabled tiles.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, tabs, ghost buttons.

tokens.name: fg-default
tokens.usage: Primary text and all money values.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata. ≥4.5:1 on surface and sunken.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text only (exempt from 4.5:1). Never for information.

tokens.name: fg-accent
tokens.usage: Accent text: notes, modifiers, active tab label.

tokens.name: fg-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text/icons on accent-bg (dark on saffron in both themes).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows inside a surface.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card and tile outlines, section dividers.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input and control boundaries (≥3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px + 2px offset. Distinct from accent on purpose.

tokens.name: accent-bg
tokens.usage: THE commit action: take payment, confirm, primary save. One per view.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft accent fill: active nav item, selected chip.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Warning text: low stock, unsaved, over/short within tolerance.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Danger text: out of stock, failed, refund amounts, validation errors.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Info text: in progress, syncing, sent to kitchen.

tokens.name: tile-selected-border
tokens.usage: Component token. Product tile already in cart.

tokens.name: cartline-selected-bg
tokens.usage: Component token. Current cart line (keyboard target).

tokens.name: nav-item-active-bg
tokens.usage: Component token. Active item in workspace nav.
